body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Sherwood has announced that Audio/Video receiver ‘Sherwood Newcastle R-972’ won an Innovation 2008 Design and Engineering Award in the Audio Components product category in CES 2008.

Sherwood R-972, the 2008 CES Innovation Award honoree, decodes all the latest high-definition audio formats such as Dolby ThruHD and DTS-HD available with Blu-ray disc and HD-DVD player, by featuring HDMI 1.3a. It also scales all video signals to 1080p for full High Definition display.
Furthermore, R-972 is the world's first A/V receiver to incorporate ‘Trinnov Optimizer’
which automatically optimize speaker set-up by detecting indivisual speaker and shape of room.
"2009 CES Innovation Award has proved again Sherwood's valuable heritige to have been a standard for innovation and performance excellance" the company's official added.
